companion_apps.name: Oclean Care +
companion_apps.notes: Not required for the documented core local sync. Close it during polling to avoid subscription conflicts and session-buffer races.

identity.notes: Retain the exact DIS model ID and route; never substitute a retail-name guess.

methods.notes: Connect for Device Information, then stop unless the exact model ID has a declared route.

identification.notes: Match the standard Oclean service only. Type F's 0000aaaa service is declared separately for implementers and is not an auto-discovery claim for this sync spec. Post-connect model-ID selection is mandatory.

device.manufacturer: Oclean / Zhuhai Ice Bear Smart Home Technology (brand relationship per public integration notice)
device.name: Oclean BLE Smart Toothbrushes
device.notes:
READ THE MODEL BEFORE WRITING. Type 0, Type 1, Type Z1, Air 1 legacy and Type F differ in command routing and payload. Select only from the exact Device Information model-ID table in protocol_details.model_routing and the observed GATT properties, never from the retail name alone. Unknown model IDs fail closed here: unlike the upstream discovery convenience fallback, this spec does not send speculative Type 1 commands to them.
Upstream-tested Oclean X (OCLEANY3M) and Oclean X Pro (OCLEANY3) are Type 1, not Type 0. Type 0 remains a documented reserved route with no confirmed production model mapping in the current open implementation.
Poll, then disconnect. Do not infer every short active-brushing interval from the 0303 status byte; upstream removed that feature. Programme IDs are numeric cloud-managed identifiers with no offline name mapping. Scores, pressure and coverage are device data, not dental or medical conclusions.
Type F is a separate Wi-Fi-capable BLE profile, not a command namespace to try after standard sync fails. Wi-Fi provisioning, cloud APIs, firmware update and destructive/settings writes are outside this spec.
Integration is identify_only until a dedicated handler implements the DIS-first lifecycle and model-routed parsers. The standard battery characteristic alone does not make the family supported, and protocol_details is not an executable mobile control surface.

openness.notes: Core battery, identity, clock and session sync are local BLE; no Oclean account or cloud is needed for that subset.

pairing.notes: The upstream X/Air 1 local clients require no pairing or account. This does not assert ATT permissions on every partial model or Type F.

credentials.notes: No pairing key or cloud token is needed for core local sync. Type F Wi-Fi credentials are not covered.
stored_on_device: Clock, programme IDs, session records and brush-head counters; exact model-dependent persistence is not fully known

factory_reset.description: Brush-head counter reset is also excluded: it is a settings write with unconfirmed read-back, not a factory reset.
factory_reset.effect: App-derived standard and Type F reset opcodes exist, but the complete state they clear and a safe owner recovery flow are not established. No factory- reset procedure is offered, and no reset opcode is used for discovery.

methods.description: First read exact DIS model/hardware/software and select a route, then calibrate on that route, then subscribe/query and disconnect; documentary until a dedicated handler exists.

steps.action: Close Oclean Care + and other clients so notification subscriptions and session retrieval do not race.
As the first command-related operation, connect and read exact Model Number, Hardware Revision and Software Revision from Device Information, then select the declared route.
steps.expect: An exact model ID present in protocol_details.model_routing with its firmware constraints satisfied; otherwise stop before any subscription, calibration, query or other write.

steps.action: Reconfirm the model route and calibrate time using only that route's command and encoding; no write may precede the known model ID.
Only after calibration, subscribe on the declared response channels, reconfirm the route before each query write, query status/device/session data, and read standard Battery Level.
steps.expect: Battery, identity and any model-supported session records decode; Air 1 instead uses its direct-read fallback when fbb86 has no CCCD.

steps.action: Stop subscriptions and disconnect after the poll.

setup.notes: No Wi-Fi provisioning, vendor account or cloud is needed for core local sync. Confidence is medium because X/Air 1 have upstream hardware evidence while other explicit routes and model-specific records are only partially verified.

rejoin.notes: Core BLE sync has no network membership or per-app credential to move. Session history can be affected by the official app syncing.

steps.action: Disconnect the old client and close the vendor app before polling from the new controller.
Read the model ID again and run the same declared sync route.
steps.expect: Core sync resumes without re-pairing; previously synchronized session buffers are not guaranteed to remain.

testing.notes: This project did not connect to a brush, collect brushing history or replay commands. Upstream reports tested core sync on Oclean X/OCLEANY3M(Y3MH) and battery/core behavior on Air 1/OCLEANA1; other models are partial or reported only. All session vectors in this spec are invented, not health history.

variants.notes: OCLEANY3M/OCLEANY3MH are Type 1. Upstream-tested core; Y3MH also has the alternate XX03 record shape.
OCLEANA1 and A1a-d use the Air 1 hybrid route and direct-read fallback; A1e/f are Type 1, not the Air 1 fallback route.

variants.model: Oclean X Pro / X Pro Elite / X Pro 20 / X Ultra families
variants.notes: Type 1 routing is reported; session details and model-specific records remain partial.
OCLEANY5 uses the Type-Z1 hybrid: ordinary queries on fbb85 and sessions on fbb89.
OCLEANY2 is Type 1 only on firmware >=1.0.0.4; older firmware uses unsupported commands.
Separate 0000aaaa profile. No model-ID mapping, provisioning, sync or compatibility claim is made.

entities.name: Battery
entities.notes: Prefer the standard read; 0303 byte 3 and 0302 byte 0 are route-specific fallbacks.

entities.name: Last Brush Duration
entities.notes: Model-specific layout in payload_formats; 42-byte records prefer plausible valid duration, inline/XX03 use their reported duration.

entities.name: Last Brush Score
entities.notes: Only when the selected record carries 1-100; inline count zero and 0/0xff are unavailable. Not a health assessment.

entities.name: Brush Head Usage
entities.notes: 0302 head_used_times where available; 0308 simple brush_head_wear_raw has unresolved increment semantics and is not converted.

artifacts.description: Current model routing, X/Air 1 core sync, parsers, Air 1 direct-read fallback and model-support matrix.
Corroborated GATT and device-type facts. No app source, identifiers, accounts or private session data are included.

evidence.documentation_review: Reviewed deniskie/ha-oclean-integration at 8b831484c92a02372ee88b1828148ab9552d1007 and current Oclean Care + 4.0.8 static evidence on 2026-11-10. The focused upstream protocol/parser/real-data set passed 372 assertions. Its broader Home Assistant suite also attempted 45 passes with 848 setup errors from event-loop fixtures; that is not described as a full-suite pass and is outside this spec's independent tests.
evidence.open_questions: Type 0 production mapping, X Pro/Elite/Z1 and year-zero record variants, Type F sync/provisioning, 0309 completion semantics, programme-name mapping, brush-head wear units, settings ACKs and every unverified write remain open.

DeviceSettings0302.description: Response 0302 to 030201. Offsets below are after the two-byte 0302 marker; multibyte counters are big-endian.

fields.description: 0-100; Air 1 fallback
fields.name: battery_percent

values.1: nonzero means online in the app

fields.description: Current integration reads bind state here; do not apply the older byte-6 layout
fields.name: bind_state_raw

fields.description: Model-family-specific active mode code, not a universal programme enum
fields.name: mode_number

fields.description: 1-based Oclean timezone-table index, not signed quarter-hours
fields.name: timezone_index

fields.description: Unit unresolved
fields.name: head_max_time_raw

fields.description: Unit unresolved
fields.name: head_used_time_raw

fields.description: Calendar days since brush-head reset
fields.name: head_used_days

fields.description: Sessions since brush-head reset on the current integration layout
fields.name: head_used_times

parse_rules: Require at least 6 payload bytes for battery/bind/mode, at least 22 for clock fields, and at least 32 for brush-head counters; 34 is the complete core layout.
This is the current integration layout: bind_state at 4 and mode_number at 5. Do not use the older reference's byte-6 bind and byte-8 mode positions.
The two head time words have no established unit; head_used_days and head_used_times are separate counters.

Session0308Extended.description: Type 0 extended session: payload begins with a big-endian record length >=32 and includes that header in the length.

fields.description: Total payload length including this field; require it before parsing
fields.name: record_length

fields.description: Preserve separately; the current extended parser reports duration_total
fields.name: valid_duration

fields.description: Five raw intermediate values; no physical unit established
fields.name: pressure_zones_raw

fields.description: Eight raw zone values; zero means no zone activity in the app
fields.name: tooth_area_values_raw

fields.description: Device score 0-100; not a health assessment
fields.name: score

fields.description: 0-8 observed; meanings unresolved
fields.name: scheme_type_raw

fields.description: Optional trailing bytes through record_length
fields.name: pressure_profile

parse_rules: Detect extended only when payload[0] == 0, payload[1] >= 32 and actual payload length >= record_length. Never fall back to simple after an extended-header match.
If payload[0] == 0 but the extended conditions fail, return no session rather than year-2000 garbage.
Apply the same UTC conversion as the simple format using signed byte 19; ignore trailing pressure-profile bytes beyond the fixed 32 for core sync.

Session0308Simple.description: Type 0 simple session: 20-byte payload after 0308, but core fields end at byte 17 and require only 18 bytes.

fields.description: Must yield a plausible calendar year
fields.name: year_since_2000

fields.description: Signed quarter-hours from UTC
fields.name: timezone_quarter_hours

fields.description: Calendar week code; indexing convention unresolved
fields.name: calendar_week_raw

fields.description: Numeric cloud-managed programme ID; no offline name mapping
fields.name: programme_id

fields.description: Usage indicator; increment mechanism/unit unresolved
fields.name: brush_head_wear_raw

fields.description: Divide raw by 300; dimensionless, no physical unit established
fields.name: pressure_raw

fields.description: Optional on longer notifications; semantics unresolved
fields.name: optional_reserved_18_19

parse_rules: Require at least 18 bytes for the core record and reject invalid calendar fields. Bytes 18-19 may be absent.
Do not confuse little-endian wear/pressure with the big-endian duration fields in extended records.

Type1Inline0307.description: 0307 | *B# | count_u16be | inline record head. Inline count zero with nonzero year carries no score or full enrichment.

fields.description: ASCII *B# at payload offsets 0-2
fields.name: magic

fields.description: Zero selects inline-only core on the tested X profile
fields.name: record_count

fields.description: Inline duration field; do not infer scheduled/valid preference
fields.name: duration_reported

fields.description: Present on longer inline payloads; not used to replace inline duration here
fields.name: valid_duration_raw

fields.description: First two raw pressure-area bytes when present
fields.name: pressure_area_prefix

parse_rules: Require at least 12 payload bytes for timestamp/programme and 14 for duration. Reject month zero and other invalid dates.
When count is zero, clear score/area/pressure enrichment left from an older session instead of carrying it forward.
A count greater than zero enters protocol_details.session_reassembly, not this inline parser.

Type1Record42.description: Tested X-family full 42-byte record after *B# reassembly; local datetime fields, big-endian durations.

fields.description: Nonzero in the tested X path; year-zero model variants are outside this parser
fields.name: year_since_2000

fields.description: Five pressure-bucket percentages, NOT tooth areas
fields.name: pressure_ratio

fields.description: 1-based timezone-table index; not a direct quarter-hour offset
fields.name: timezone_index

fields.description: Eight per-zone values; byte 30 also participates in packed fields
fields.name: gesture_array_raw

fields.description: Two-bit code after masking bits 2-3 and shifting right two
fields.name: gesture_code

fields.description: Bytes 30-32, each split MSB-first into four 2-bit values
fields.name: power_array_prefix

fields.description: 0-100; 0 and 0xff mean unavailable
fields.name: score

fields.description: Rating point; not exposed by the current integration
fields.name: point_raw

parse_rules: Require exactly one complete 42-byte record and a valid nonzero calendar year. Do not infer a year for year-zero model variants here.
actual_duration = valid_duration when valid > 0 and (scheduled == 0 or valid <= scheduled); otherwise scheduled when scheduled > 0; otherwise unknown.
Preserve local date/time and timezone_index separately; do not apply the 0308 quarter-hour formula to this record.
Bytes 11-15 are pressure ratios. Per-zone gesture values are at 23-30; neither is a dental-health conclusion.

XX03Session.description: OCLEANY3MH alternate 20-byte notification with score in byte 0 instead of a fixed response marker.

fields.description: Emit only 1-100; 0 and values >100 unavailable
fields.name: score

fields.description: Must be 03 03
fields.name: fingerprint_03_03

fields.description: Must be five 0xff bytes
fields.name: separator_ff

fields.description: Use this duration; do not apply the verified 42-byte valid-duration preference
fields.name: duration_reported

fields.description: Field order unconfirmed; do not substitute as valid duration
fields.name: trailing_raw

parse_rules: Require at least 20 bytes, data[1:3] == 03 03 and data[4:9] == ff ff ff ff ff; otherwise this is not XX03.
Validate the calendar and keep device-local time because this layout supplies no direct signed timezone offset.

air1_read_fallback.battery_fallback: 0302 payload byte 0 when the 0303 or standard battery value is unavailable/stale
air1_read_fallback.failure_policy: Do not require a CCCD, do not subscribe to fbb89, and do not pretend an empty read is a session.
air1_read_fallback.operation: Read fbb86 directly after route queries and feed each nonempty value through the normal 0303/0302/0307 parser
air1_read_fallback.trigger: fbb86 has no CCCD or subscription fails on OCLEANA1/A1a-d

excluded_operations: Factory-reset and brush-head reset writes; neither is used for discovery or safe sync
Settings, programme upload, calibration, OTA and Type F Wi-Fi provisioning
Cloud programme-name mapping, account APIs and concurrent official-app synchronization
Active-brushing detection from polling and any medical/dental-health conclusion
Real brushing history in test vectors; every session vector here is invented

air1_legacy.constraints: Do not subscribe to fbb89 or require fbb90. A1e/A1f are Type 1 instead.
notifications: fbb86 when a CCCD exists; otherwise direct reads

model_routing.selection: Exact case-sensitive DIS Model Number match, checked before every command write; unknown means stop

type0.status: Reserved in the current implementation; no confirmed production model IDs. OCLEANY3M and OCLEANY3 are NOT Type 0.

type1.constraints: OCLEANY2 requires firmware >=1.0.0.4. fbb89 is write-only; no 0309 pagination.

queries.response: fbb90 *B# stream on the tested X path

type_f.support: Separate and unverified: no model mapping, sync commands, Wi-Fi provisioning or fallback claim

model_routing.unknown_model_policy: Return unsupported and log the exact ID for research. Do not default to Type 1, Type 0 or Type F.

session_reassembly.applies_to: Tested X-family Type 1 42-byte profile; other record widths are not claimed
session_reassembly.completion: Parse each complete 42-byte record once, discard any surplus only after the expected records are handled, and reset state before another header.
session_reassembly.continuation: Append raw continuation bytes to inline bytes until record_count * 42 bytes are buffered. Continuations have no header and may begin with any value, including a response marker.
session_reassembly.duplicates: A strictly newer timestamp replaces current session state. Equal timestamps do not overwrite it and are appended only once to history.
session_reassembly.stale_enrichment: Inline count zero means no score/area/pressure enrichment; clear those fields rather than retaining an earlier record's values.
session_reassembly.truncation: At end-of-wait, complete records may be flushed; a final partial record is dropped. Never pad it or interpret its prefix as a record.

order.failure_policy: Unknown or mismatched model ID stops here; no route fallback and no later lifecycle operation
order.selection: Read exact Model Number, Hardware Revision and Software Revision, then select the case-sensitive model route and apply firmware constraints before any subscription, calibration, query or other write

order.route: Use only the selected route's time command and encoding after the exact model ID is known
Subscribe on the selected route's response channels and standard battery when supported
Run selected-route queries, then Air 1 direct-read fallback if required
Type 0 only; wait for no new page
Read standard battery unless already notified, then disconnect

sync_lifecycle.write_guard: Reconfirm the exact model ID and selected route before every write; if identity is not pinned to this connection, reread DIS first. No write may precede a known model ID.

time_calibration.timezone_index_rule: Choose the 1-based index of the nearest offset in this table; on an exact tie the first (lower-offset) entry wins.
time_calibration.type1_payload: [year-2000, month, day, hour, minute, second, weekday (0 Sunday..6 Saturday), timezone_index]

remaining_unknowns: No confirmed production Type 0 model-ID mapping exists in the current implementation; do not revive the outdated OCLEANY3 Type 0 route.
X Pro/Elite/Z1 and year-zero/40-byte model-specific record paths need owner-controlled read-only captures before claiming complete sync.
Type F models, Wi-Fi provisioning, cloud behavior and OTA are separate unverified surfaces.
Pagination termination, schemeType labels, programme names, pressure units and brush-head wear units are not fully established.
The 0303 byte is not a reliable active-brushing sensor, and official-app syncing can clear or race session buffers.
No model-specific official manual was verified; no manual link is included.

format.name: status_raw
format.notes: Do not infer reliable active-brushing state from this polling byte

format_match.notes: 0303 status only; 0302/0307/0308 and XX03 use payload_formats instead

characteristics.name: Main Response / Notify
characteristics.notes: 0303 status requires at least 6 bytes total; payload byte 3 (absolute offset 5) is battery 0-100. Other status bytes are not a supported live activity surface. On OCLEANA1 this characteristic can lack a CCCD; use protocol_details.air1_read_fallback rather than treating subscription as mandatory.

characteristics.name: Standard Command Write
characteristics.notes: Documentary write endpoint only while integration is identify_only. Route-specific calibration and query bytes remain in protocol_details.model_routing and time_calibration; no generic executable command is declared because a dedicated handler must read and reconfirm the exact DIS model route before every write.

characteristics.name: Type 0 Change Information
characteristics.notes: Type 0 only. Do not require this characteristic on Type 1, Z1 or Air 1.

characteristics.name: Type 1 / Z1 / Air 1 Session Command Write
characteristics.notes: Write-only on tested Type 1 units; never subscribe to this characteristic. Session query bytes are documentary in protocol_details.model_routing while integration is identify_only. No generic executable command is declared without the dedicated exact-DIS route guard.

characteristics.name: Type 1 / Z1 Session Notifications
characteristics.notes: Subscribe on Type 1 and Z1, not Air 1 legacy. Raw continuation chunks follow a 0307 *B# header on the tested X profile.

services.name: Oclean Standard Service
services.notes: Type 0/Type 1/Type Z1/Air 1 only. Route by DIS model ID before any write.

characteristics.name: Model Number String
characteristics.notes: Exact case-sensitive model ID used for protocol selection; read before command writes.

characteristics.name: Software Revision String
characteristics.notes: OCLEANY2 below 1.0.0.4 is unsupported by this Type 1 route.

characteristics.name: Battery Level
characteristics.notes: Standard one-byte percentage, 0-100. Reject values above 100.

characteristics.name: Type F Write (reserved)
characteristics.notes: No commands are declared; compatibility and payloads are unverified.

characteristics.name: Type F Read / Notify (reserved)
characteristics.notes: No parser or sync sequence is claimed.

services.name: Oclean Type F Service (separate; no sync claim)
services.notes: Type F is not an alternative routing fallback for standard models. The public reference gives F2xx/F3xx/F7xx command namespaces, but no tested Type F sync, model mapping or Wi-Fi provisioning is claimed here. Do not send standard commands.
